result.instructions: Researching with Tavily: when a result names a likely answer, read its page with tavily_extract to confirm it before searching more, and name the candidate in your next query when testing it. Keep your best candidate until a source contradicts it; if none confirms it, also search the main alternative by name. Once new searches stop adding evidence, answer with the best-supported candidate, from sources rather than memory, and say what you could not confirm.

serverInfo.name: exa-search-server
serverInfo.title: Exa
serverInfo.description: Exa web search, page fetching and research-agent tools for AI agents over MCP.

result.instructions: Only use tools returned by tools/list. If web_search_exa is listed, use it to find relevant pages and current information by describing the page you want to find. If web_fetch_exa is listed, use it to read known URLs when search highlights are insufficient or you already have a URL. If agent_run is listed, use it for multi-step research, list-building, or enrichment. If a run is still running, continue with its runId rather than starting a duplicate run.
